description: Monica and Chandler settle into marriage while Rachel's pregnancy with Ross becomes the group's central story, Joey develops unexpected feelings for Rachel and the season ends with Emma's birth and a badly timed misunderstanding.

s08e01.description: Monica and Chandler's reception continues as everyone tries to identify the pregnant guest, while Ross tries to impress Mona and Joey struggles to remove his film costume.

s08e02.description: A forgotten red sweater becomes the clue that reveals Ross is the father of Rachel's baby, while Monica obsesses over opening wedding presents.

s08e03.description: Rachel tells Ross he is the father, leading to an emotional confrontation about how they conceived while Monica and Chandler experience an awkward first marital crisis.

s08e04.description: Ross and Rachel argue over who initiated the night that led to her pregnancy until a videotape provides humiliating evidence.

s08e05.description: Rachel worries pregnancy has ended her dating life, while Ross is uncomfortable about her going out and Monica struggles with Chandler's coworkers.

s08e06.description: Monica and Chandler host a costume party where Phoebe meets Ursula's fiancé, Ross and Chandler arm-wrestle and Rachel discovers she is terrible with children.

s08e07.description: Monica becomes obsessed with a mysterious stain in the apartment, while Chandler hires a maid and Joey tries to convince Rachel to let him help with the baby.

s08e08.description: Rachel's father confronts Ross about the pregnancy, while Monica hires what she thinks is a stripper for Chandler's delayed bachelor party.

s08e09.description: Will, an old schoolmate who hated Rachel, joins Thanksgiving and reveals that he and Ross once founded an 'I Hate Rachel' club and spread a damaging rumor.

s08e10.description: Monica refuses to admit her expensive boots are painfully impractical, while Joey's sister Dina asks Rachel for help after becoming pregnant.

s08e11.description: Mona pushes Ross toward a couple's holiday card before he is ready, while Chandler's boss makes an awkward invitation and Rachel's hormones complicate life.

s08e12.description: Joey takes Rachel on a practice date that unexpectedly awakens real feelings for her, while Monica and Chandler discover the delights of a highly addictive arcade game.

s08e13.description: Chandler discovers he enjoys baths after mocking them, while Joey's feelings for Rachel deepen and Ross and Rachel debate baby names.

s08e14.description: Chandler becomes obsessed with discovering what Monica keeps in a locked closet, while Phoebe helps Joey cope with his feelings for Rachel.

s08e15.description: Monica gives Chandler a graphic birthing video just before Valentine's Day, while Joey struggles to tell Ross he has feelings for Rachel.

s08e16.description: Joey confesses his love to Rachel and is gently rejected, while Phoebe tries to distract Chandler and Monica from discovering the truth too soon.

s08e17.description: Phoebe's tea leaves suggest she will meet the man of her dreams, while Rachel tries to repair her friendship with Joey after his confession.

s08e18.description: Monica and Ross deliver an increasingly absurd anniversary toast at their parents' party, while Phoebe brings Parker, whose relentless enthusiasm exhausts everyone.

s08e19.description: Joey's interview with Soap Opera Digest forces him to remember past career mistakes and try not to repeat the arrogant comments that once got him fired.

s08e20.description: Rachel's baby shower makes her realize how unprepared she is for motherhood, while Monica and Phoebe forget to invite Rachel's mother.

s08e21.description: Monica attends a beginner cooking class to confront a bad restaurant review but becomes addicted to being praised, while Ross and Rachel shop for baby furniture.

s08e22.description: Rachel grows increasingly desperate to give birth after passing her due date, while Monica and Phoebe make bets about when labor will begin.

s08e23-24.description: Rachel enters a crowded maternity ward and endures a parade of other couples giving birth while Ross stays with her through a long labor. Rachel gives birth to Emma, Joey accidentally appears to propose, and Ross's plan to tell Rachel how he feels is derailed by the misunderstanding.
